scenario: Exact local bearer permits and irreversible revocation for historical write actions

stages.label: exact-action-and-private-bearer-scope
stages.explanation: A fifth write job has an explicit catalog, one lease claim and one prepared-to-ready action. A private bearer permit captures exactly that action; exact issue replay returns its fixed grant and show observes an active permit without authenticating a holder.

stages.label: authenticated-delivery-and-one-saved-effect
stages.explanation: Wrong credentials refuse execute and revoke. Two ordinary protected execute processes are launched before collection for one permit and return the same complete response; the write reaches only ready. The response verifies current local capability delivery and explicitly declines historical effect authentication.

stages.label: revocation-blocks-protected-historical-replay
stages.explanation: The holder irreversibly revokes the fill permit. Protected replay refuses even though the result exists. Old action show/execute still return historical evidence; exact revoke replay is fixed and exact issue replay does not reactivate the permit.

stages.label: independent-replacement-does-not-revive-revocation
stages.explanation: A second permit is revoked before its link action runs, leaving the write ready. A new independent permit for the same exact action performs ready-to-linked. The original permit still refuses; replacement does not renew or reactivate it and its principal remains a self-declared label.

stages.label: whole-protected-reply-recovery-and-offline-revocation
stages.explanation: Finish completes with its captured catalog absent; the actual complete protected reply is discarded and recovered exactly. After lease release and hiding four bindings, active replacement replay checks its bearer and returns saved history. Hiding all three actions raises the total to seven absent paths: own-only show/issue replay and finish revoke still work, while revoked protected execute refuses before missing-action access. All paths return in finally.

stages.label: exact-inputs-and-unchanged-domain-history
stages.explanation: Changed exact requests and malformed identifiers refuse without creating new permits. Four earlier write jobs, earlier released lease heads and three blocked restore jobs preserve their observations. Four grants retain three irreversible revocations; three fresh actions retain exactly three performed phases and the replacement permit stays active over historical evidence.

limits: A permit is a private local bearer capability for one exact historical action; its principal is a self-declared label and the filesystem owner remains the issuer. No person, external identity, semantic approval or domain authority is established.

One bearer executes and may revoke its own permit. Revocation is irreversible through this API and has no expiry. A new permit for the same action is independent and never reactivates an earlier revoked permit.

Every protected execute checks the supplied credential and current own revocation state before action or cached-result access. The full response is stable for exact reply recovery, but historical_effect_authenticated remains false: authenticated delivery does not establish who caused an earlier effect.

Old action show/execute still expose historical evidence without this bearer gate; direct write step, filesystem ownership and other ledgers remain outside permit admission. job_steps_enforced is false and no external fencing or common SQL/filesystem transaction exists.
Two callers launch before collection and share one exact saved response; this does not measure process overlap, maximum agents, useful throughput, independent models or semantic correctness.

The actual complete finish response is discarded after a successful ordinary command and recovered exactly. No interruption, partial-result repair, power loss, clock regression or expiry waiting is demonstrated.

Completion needs no captured catalog. Cached protected replay still authenticates an active bearer after lease release with four bindings absent. Permit own-only show, exact issue replay and revoke need no action, and revoked execute refuses before seven missing bindings are accessed. Every detached path returns in finally.

The driver reads validated public responses, private credential markers and lstat metadata. It never reads private control bodies, action results, lease SQL rows or staging contents; tokens, credential hashes and control digests stay private.

The earlier source/live histories remain R4/36 and R5/59, with previous quarantine, origin and blocked restore cases. New controls neither archive nor delete content and do not activate old authority.
